title: Qareeb Flutter packages
tagline: Shared Dart packages from the Qareeb ecosystem: models, map helpers, drawable text, multi-type images.
overview: Tiny Dart libraries extracted from Qareeb so the rider/driver apps do not each own a copy of models, map widgets, drawable text, and multi-type images. Grouped here instead of four weak case studies.
problem: Copy-pasted models and image/text widgets across Qareeb apps drifted out of sync.
solution: Publish qareeb_models, map_qareeb, qarreb-drawable_text, and qarreb-image-multi-type as their own repos.
architecture: Four small Dart packages on GitHub under ammarshamea. Consumed by the Qareeb Flutter clients.
challenges: Naming drift (qareeb vs qarreb) across early package repos
lessonsLearned: Extract packages when a second app needs the same widget, not before
futureImprovements: pub.dev-style versioning and a single qareeb_* naming prefix
results: Four public Dart packages instead of four padded case studies
